title: Certificates for Computer-assisted Morse indices of nonmagnetic Ginzburg-Landau vortices of degrees four through eight
description:
Exact rational certificates give full-plane Morse indices 12, 20, 30, 36 and 48 for degrees 4 through 8 under the report’s analytic hypotheses. The conjectured upper bound n(n-1) is attained at 4 through 6 and strict at 7 and 8. Bounded-kernel nondegeneracy is proved for degree four. Lean checks degree-four polynomial statements and 15 of 97 higher-degree files (96 generated integer-list modules plus the root import). The spectral and variational arguments and the complete higher-degree chain lie outside Lean. Tail5M2 passed at the supplied 10000 MB kernel limit after exceeding 5000 MB. No experiments were performed.

AI agents generated proofs, certificates, code, Lean sources and manuscript drafts and edits under D. Rens’s direction and review.
